verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Pinecone serves a live llms.txt at docs.pinecone.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200), describing its official docs for the vector database, Assistant, inference APIs and SDKs. Its official MCP server also lets agents search the Pinecone documentation directly, and there are docs for agentic tools like Claude Code and Cursor. Missing for 10: no evidence on how deep or complete the llms.txt content is (e.g., a full-content variant or per-page markdown versions).
